page.overview:
Who is Diego?

Diego or Dieguito was a Costa Rican man who guided Dr. Richard Levine part of the way across Isla Sorna.

He knew the outline of the island very well as he visited it previously as a young boy. He carried most of the equipment as they climbed up one of the cliffs to get on the island. He was amazed by even the smallest dinosaurs. Levine considered him sloppy and careless, such as making too much noise or smoking when he had been specifically told not to. Diego was dragged into the bushes and was killed by a Carnotaurus. Levine only noted which kind of dinosaur killed Diego later on.

Diego had a cousin named Gandoca who owned a boat. He gave doctors Lewis Dodgson, Howard King, George Baselton, and Sarah Harding a boat ride to Isla Sorna.
